verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents several headless and automation paths. `opencode run` runs a one-shot non-interactive prompt, `opencode serve` runs a headless HTTP server with an OpenAPI endpoint, and a JS/TS SDK controls it programmatically. It also has an official GitHub Actions integration that runs tasks in the runner and opens PRs, and `--auto` approves permission requests unattended. A community user independently confirms running `opencode serve` as a remotely accessed service. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CI pipeline use (e.g., the GitHub Actions workflow), and documentation of CI-oriented details such as structured output or exit codes for `opencode run`.
